meta.move: After the end, asks for more feedback
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until twenty to five, Hale. My son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and when?
The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero.

A machine's guess, and you entered a zero on it before you spoke to Owen or picked up the phone. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone does not establish a concern. So what else do you have, or is that it?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing placed on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and Owen's record kept clean.
What moved her: nothing, because no dated document tied to Owen's own work was ever put in front of her.
What cost ground: leading with the detector score as the whole basis for the zero, because to her it is a machine's opinion and it confirmed the school punished first.
Try next time: open by owning, in one sentence, that the zero went in before anyone called her, then show her something dated from Owen's own work that she can check herself.
Can you give me more detailed feedback on how I did?
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
